readmeExcerpt:
# WOTS+ Solidity Implementation

A Solidity implementation of the Winternitz One-Time Signature Plus (WOTS+) scheme.

## Development

This project uses Foundry for development and testing.

### Prerequisites

Install Foundry:
```bash
curl -L https://foundry.paradigm.xyz | bash
foundryup
```

### Testing

Run the Foundry tests:
```bash
forge test -vv
```

The `-vv` flag increases verbosity to show more test details. Use `-vvv` for even more detailed output including stack traces.

### Building

```bash
forge build
```

aiSummary.oneLiner: A Solidity implementation of the Winternitz One-Time Signature Plus scheme providing post-quantum security.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This project provides a Solidity implementation of the WOTS+ (Winternitz One-Time Signature Plus) scheme, a specialized hash-based cryptographic algorithm. It introduces practical post-quantum signature verification directly into Ethereum smart contracts. By relying solely on secure hash functions rather than the discrete logarithm problem or integer factorization, WOTS+ is theoretically resistant to attacks from quantum computers. The implementation is designed to be efficiently deployed on EVM-compatible blockchains, allowing decentralized applications to verify signatures that are secure against future quantum cryptographic threats.
keyFeatures: WOTS+ Implementation: Provides a complete, tested Solidity realization of the robust Winternitz One-Time Signature Plus cryptographic scheme.
Post-Quantum Resistance: Utilizes hash-based cryptography, protecting digital signatures against potential Shor's algorithm attacks from quantum computers.
EVM Compatibility: Specifically designed for efficient deployment and execution on Ethereum and other standard EVM-compatible blockchain networks.
Foundry Integration: Uses the modern Foundry toolkit for development, comprehensive testing, and streamlined deployment workflows.
On-Chain Verification: Enables smart contracts to natively and autonomously verify WOTS+ signatures without relying on external off-chain oracles.

useCases.title: Quantum-Resistant Multisigs
useCases.description: Allows the creation of highly secure multi-signature wallets that remain safe even if standard Elliptic Curve Cryptography is broken by quantum computers.

useCases.title: Long-Term Data Notarization
useCases.description: Provides a verifiable way to sign and anchor critical documents on-chain with a strict guarantee of long-term cryptographic integrity.

useCases.title: Secure Cross-Chain Bridges
useCases.description: Enhances the fundamental security of cross-chain messaging protocols by utilizing advanced post-quantum signature verification.

useCases.title: Future-Proofing Smart Contracts
useCases.description: Enables forward-thinking developers to build decentralized applications that anticipate and mathematically mitigate the emerging threat of quantum computing.
